status: draft binding reference tests, not shared conformance vectors

wrong-type.html.reason: M1: FHR identity is not FHT

unknown-release.html.reason: V7: no FHT release is available

repeated-scalar.html.reason: M4: repeated scalar becomes an invalid list

object-without-scope.html.reason: M3: typed object requires its own item scope

array-stray-text.html.reason: M4: array containers contain only item properties

mixed-family.html.reason: M1: reject conflicting family record scopes

script-required-value.html.reason: M2: script content cannot supply a required value

wrong-version-type.html.reason: contract: schemaVersion must remain the string 1.0

repeated-array-container.html.reason: M4: repeated array containers remain nested and fail the array item schema

hidden-attribute.html.reason: Visible values: a hidden property is not shown in the page

display-none-ancestor.html.reason: Visible values: an ancestor with display:none hides the value

hidden-scope.html.reason: Visible values: the FHT scope itself is concealed

meta-content.html.reason: Visible values: a meta content attribute is never shown

noscript-property.html.reason: Visible values: noscript contents are not rendered when scripting is enabled

itemref.html.reason: Visible values: itemref pulls properties from outside the item

multi-token-itemprop.html.reason: Visible values: one element cannot supply two fields

javascript-href.html.reason: R14: an active href outside http/https/ftp/urn/doi/info

data-value-differs.html.reason: Visible values: a data value attribute must equal the text shown
